Lena (marketing): quick sync: need a fresh benchmark narrative for next week's launch. goal: show engineers & PMs how to read latency vs. cost tradeoffs and decide routing + trials. short reactions pls :wave:
Omar (growth): ok — prioritize clarity for lead routing. can we give concrete thresholds?
Rina (product): yes. propose two visuals: 1) heatmap based on latency (x) vs $/1k tokens (y) with use-case callouts; 2) small multiples showing fastpath vs fallback token cost per 1k at different batch sizes
Theo (design): i'll mock up a compact slide deck. color scheme: cool blues for low cost/latency, warm reds for high. will ensure WCAG contrast and colorblind-safe palette
Nico (demand): routing POV: we need an explicit inbound matrix so marketing can wire forms. propose fields: avg_context_length, intent_score, org_size. rules to map to PLG/SMB/Enterprise buckets
Lena (marketing): copy direction: "Heatmap the tradeoffs: pick the model path that meets your latency SLO and budget." two variants: engineer-friendly (metrics heavy) and PM-friendly (use-cases + outcomes)
Omar (growth): webinar structure idea: 6m context, 10m live bench demo (heatmap reveal), 14m deep dive on 3 slices + routing, 20m customer use cases + moderated q&a, 10m CTA & next steps. 60m total
Rina (product): slices = PLG (<= 200ms median, < $0.80 per 1k tokens for small prompts), SMB (~200-600ms, $0.8-2/1k typical), Enterprise (>600ms, >$2/1k, long contexts). we'll phrase costs as examples not promises
Theo (design): quick ascii layout for heatmap slide:
[Latency ->] low | medium | high
[$/1k]
low   [PLG green] [PLG->SMB yellow] [SMB orange]
mid   [PLG->SMB yellow] [SMB orange] [Enterprise red]
high  [SMB orange] [Enterprise red] [Enterprise red]
Theo (design): i'll annotate each cell with suggested routing action and a 6-word use case blurb
Nico (demand): for routing matrix, here's a starter:```
- intent_score >= 8 AND org_size >= 100 -> AE outreach
- intent_score >= 6 AND avg_context_length < 300 -> SDR
- trial_user AND intent_score >=5 -> Growth nurture
- long-context samples (>1024 tokens) -> Solutions eng follow-up
```
Lena (marketing): good. also want 3 poll questions during webinar: which slice fits you?, what's your primary SLO (latency/cost/quality)?, interest in trial? collect email on poll submit
Omar (growth): BenchBot — can you generate sample webhook payloads for each slice we can plug into the demo router?
BenchBot: done — uploaded sample payloads and a small csv of thresholds: https://drive.example.com/bench_demo_payloads (files: plg_payload.json, smb_payload.json, enterprise_payload.json, routing_thresholds.csv) :robot_face:
Rina (product): on slide copy, add a one-liner about fallbacks: "If fastpath capacity is saturated, requests will transparently fall back to the nearest compatible model variant to preserve availability." short and concrete
Theo (design): will produce two slide styles: technical (charts + numbers) and storytelling (use-cases + callouts). will share figma link by 18:00 PT
Nico (demand): i'll recruit 2 customers for panel: one scale-startup (SMB) and one platform (Enterprise). will prep 3 talking prompts each
Lena (marketing): action list: Theo -> figma slides + annotated heatmap, Rina -> sample payloads + fallback one-liner (add to README), Omar -> poll + inbound form fields, Nico -> panel confirmations + prompts, me -> post copy variants + webinar landing draft. deadline EOD Wednesday
Omar (growth): also: recommend adding a small section showing how quantization can shift a model left on the heatmap (lower cost, slightly higher latency). helps explain tradeoffs
Rina (product): added. will include a tiny before/after mini-chart showing 8-bit quant vs fp16 for a sample model
Theo (design): copy note: keep axes labeled with units and provide a tooltip example for "$ per 1k" so PMs don't debate units live
Lena (marketing): perfect. small ask: keep the language concise and avoid absolute guarantees. we'll include a snapshot of the test harness and config in the follow-up doc
BenchBot: posted test harness gist and config link: https://gist.example.com/bench-harness (files: run_bench.sh, config.yml) :robot_face:
Lena (marketing): great work team. i'll assemble the draft deck and ping for a 30-min review tomorrow morning. thanks :rocket:
